messages:
Anya: Quick brief  Q3 inbound needs: landing hero, 3 benchmark micro-tiles, compact SDR routing strip, and webinar cover. Final assets by Fri EOD.
Mira: Got it. What do the benchmark tiles need to show?
Anya: Hosted p50=86ms cost=$0.0024; Dedicated p50=64ms cost=$0.0016; Private p50=71ms cost=$0.0020. Callout: Dedicated = most cost-efficient at scale.
Jackie: Brand rules: new palette (navy/coral/muted-green), Inter type scale, flat 2-color icons, AA contrast. Tiles = icon + 3 metrics + 1-line insight.
Sam: Routing logic: score >= 60 -> SDR queue + Slack alert; score < 60 -> 7-day nurture drip. Use compact legend and color-coded arrows.
Mira: Deliverables: Figma with pages (hero/tiles/routing), PNGs 1200x628 + 640x360 + 1920x1080. Localization layers for en-US/en-GB. First draft Thu noon, final Fri EOD.
Leo: Legal note: avoid absolutes like "cheapest". Use "most cost-efficient at scale" + footnote: "Based on internal Redwood performance tests, June 2025." I'll review Thu PM.
Mira: Small design Q: iconography flat or outline?
Jackie: Flat, two-color fills. Also include small "fallback" badge on benchmark tiles: icon + "fallback to compatible variants".
Anya: CTA text: Hero = "Register for benchmark webinar"; Tile link = "Read the full benchmark". Include UTM example utm_campaign=cohort_q3&utm_source=social.
design-bot: Checklist created: [Figma master file, PNG 1200x628, PNG 640x360, PNG 1920x1080, source SVG icons, localization-ready text layers, export manifest].
Mira: Uploading draft figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/Inbound-Q3-Visuals  will post when available. Please comment on frames not in Slack.
Anya: Thanks all  Jackie does brand sweep, Leo does legal, Sam confirms routing. Ping here for blockers. :rocket:
